name: Wittenberge (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Wittenberge (a red castle below a red eagle on white).
history: Municipal flag of Wittenberge; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wittenberge arms — red castle and eagle on white
